## Plan-review remediation (2026-08-07)

The first review BLOCKED because the consumer inventory was incomplete. The plan of record now includes these additional edits:

- `src/rebar/schemas/__init__.py`: remove the `BRIDGE_STATUS` export, constant, and `OUTPUT_SCHEMAS["bridge_status"]` entry together with `bridge_status.schema.json`.
- `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads_cli.py`: replace both live `Run: ticket bridge-status for details.` warnings with neutral guidance to inspect unresolved bridge alerts. Do not point at `bridge status` because that sibling command has not landed yet.
- `src/rebar/_engine_support/output.py`: remove `bridge-status` from the report-profile documentation.
- `docs/output-schemas.md`: remove the `bridge-status` to `bridge_status` row.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: add the two retirement release notes. Existing historical entries remain intentionally.

The B6 oracle is exact: a behavioral contract test proves both retired CLI tokens are unknown and absent from top-level help, then asserts zero `bridge-status` or `purge-bridge` matches in the shipped package tree `src/rebar` and the active command-contract docs `docs/cli-reference.md`, `docs/exit-codes.md`, and `docs/output-schemas.md`. Tests, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `docs/archive` are excluded because they intentionally retain specification or historical evidence.

Supplemental acceptance criteria, split for independent verification:

- [ ] `rebar bridge-status` exits as an unknown command.
- [ ] `rebar purge-bridge` exits as an unknown command.
- [ ] Neither retired command appears in `rebar --help`.
- [ ] The schema registry has no `BRIDGE_STATUS` export, constant, or output-schema entry.
- [ ] Both surviving read warnings provide neutral bridge-alert guidance and name no retired or not-yet-shipped command.
- [ ] The shipped-package and active-doc zero-match oracle passes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` records both retirements.

## Context and intent

Retire the two bridge verbs that were dead on arrival: `rebar bridge-status` and
`rebar purge-bridge`. This pure dead-code deletion was carved out of
`4752-3afb-e8bd-448a` so it could land independently; nothing in the new `bridge`
surface replaces either verb.

`bridge-status` consumed `<tracker>/.bridge-status.json`, but this repository never
contained a producer and the command exited 1 on post-cutover repositories. Its module
also carried a dangling `epic 3a03` citation. `purge-bridge` had no script, workflow,
or runbook caller and exposed an inverted-sense `--keep` flag. Neither command warranted
a compatibility alias or deprecation forwarder.

## Completed implementation

Gerrit change 1517 (`Ic40ab04419a5ebfb4e0b6486cb1272309f4dfc67`) merged to
`main` on 2026-08-07 after `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and zero unresolved
comments. The merged implementation has these observable end states:

- CLI wiring in `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py` contains only the surviving
  `bridge-fsck` entry in `_BRIDGE`; the `bridge-status` and `purge-bridge` dispatch
  arms are absent. Top-level `rebar doctor` remains unchanged.
- `src/rebar/_engine_support/bridge.py` and
  `src/rebar/_commands/purge_bridge.py` are absent, with no shims or aliases.
- `src/rebar/_cli/help/bridge-status.txt`,
  `src/rebar/_cli/help/purge-bridge.txt`, and both overview entries are absent.
- `src/rebar/schemas/bridge_status.schema.json`, the `BRIDGE_STATUS` export and
  constant, and the `OUTPUT_SCHEMAS["bridge_status"]` entry are absent.
- The retired-only tests are absent:
  `tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_status.py`,
  `tests/unit/test_purge_bridge_locked_commit.py`,
  `tests/interfaces/store/test_purge_bridge_prune_concurrency.py`, and
  `tests/interfaces/store/_purge_race_worker.py`.
- `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_schema_coverage.py` has no retired schema
  exemption. `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_help_overview_coverage.py` asserts both
  tokens are retired. `tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_alert_display.py` positively
  verifies neutral guidance from both surviving bridge-alert warning paths.
- `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads_cli.py` names no retired or not-yet-shipped
  command, and `src/rebar/_engine_support/output.py` no longer documents a
  `bridge-status` report profile.
- Active command documentation was updated in `docs/cli-reference.md`,
  `docs/exit-codes.md`, and `docs/output-schemas.md`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` records the breaking removals. `docs/release-notes.md` is an
  enumerated, intentional consumer: it records the agent-visible removal of both
  commands and the `bridge_status` output schema. Those historical retirement names
  are expected there and are not stale live-surface references.
- `.github/complexity-baseline.json` carries the resulting shrink of `_dispatch`.

No persisted ticket data, migration, external integration, auth boundary, or shared
state format changed.

## Verification evidence

- Held-out retirement contract: 7/7 tests passed. Restoring `bridge-status` made the
  oracle fail, and the refactoring litmus passed.
- Focused post-rebase contracts: 41 passed across help, schema, and alert-display tests.
- Local gates: `make lint` passed; `make typecheck` passed across 437 source files.
- Full pre-rebase suite: 11,149 passed, 40 skipped, 228 deselected.
- Exact patch-set-2 CI run 31218769114 passed artifact provenance, optionality,
  dependency audit, identity, ticket resolution, golden path, lint/typecheck, and all
  macOS/Ubuntu Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 test matrices.
- The behavioral oracle proves both retired tokens take the unknown-command path and
  are absent from top-level help. Live package and command-contract surfaces contain
  no `bridge-status` or `purge-bridge` references. Tests, changelogs, archives, and the
  explicit retirement notice in `docs/release-notes.md` retain intentional history.

## Rollback

If an undiscovered downstream consumer still invokes either retired verb, revert
Gerrit change 1517. No data migration or persisted-format reversal is required.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `rebar bridge-status` exits as an unknown command.
- [x] `rebar purge-bridge` exits as an unknown command.
- [x] Neither retired command appears in `rebar --help`.
- [x] Both implementation modules are deleted without shims or aliases.
- [x] The retired schema and every `BRIDGE_STATUS` registry surface are absent.
- [x] Surviving read warnings provide neutral bridge-alert guidance.
- [x] The package/help/active-command-doc oracle passes, with historical evidence
      explicitly scoped and retained.
- [x] Retired-only tests are deleted and replacement behavioral contracts pass.
- [x] Active command docs, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `docs/release-notes.md` record the
      correct post-removal contract.
- [x] The dangling `epic 3a03` citation disappeared with its retired module.
- [x] `bridge-fsck` and top-level `rebar doctor` behavior remain intact.
